# PVPspinArena

> PVPspinArena (https://pvpspinarena.com) is a player-vs-player crypto gaming site with six games: Jackpot, Coinflip, Roulette, P2P Slott, six-max No-Limit Texas Hold'em, and 1v1 8-ball. Balances are shown in US dollars and funded with Bitcoin, or with USDC or ETH on Base. Draws publish a SHA-256 seed hash before the round and reveal the seed after settlement. 8-ball's seed only racks the balls; the winner is a replay of the shots. Adults 18+ only. Play only with money you can afford to lose.

Jackpot, Coinflip, P2P Slott, Poker and 8-ball are player versus player: the pot is the players' wagers, and the winner receives it minus the fee for that game. Roulette is a shared house-banked wheel, not a pot. The browser animation does not decide the result. A committed seed lets you recompute a published draw. An 8-ball replay lets you recompute the winner from the shots. Neither check insures a balance, protects a wallet, or removes the fee. PVPspinArena is not affiliated with Valve, Counter-Strike, or Steam. No gambling licence number, audit firm, or company registration is published on the site.

## Games

- [Jackpot](https://pvpspinarena.com/): shared pot; every cent is one ticket, so win chance equals your share of the pot. Fee: 5% of the pot at settlement. The winner receives 95%.
- [Coinflip](https://pvpspinarena.com/coinflip): one versus one; one player picks heads or tails, the other takes the opposite side; one bit of HMAC-SHA256 gives each side a 50% chance. Fee: 5% of the combined pot. The winner receives 95%.
- [Roulette](https://pvpspinarena.com/roulette): timed rounds on a 33-slot wheel; 16 Purple and 16 Silver pay 2x, 1 Green pays 14x. Fee: 5% of each winning payout. After that fee, Purple or Silver returns about 92.12% (about a 7.88% house edge) and Green returns about 40.30% (about a 59.70% house edge).
- [P2P Slott](https://pvpspinarena.com/slott): two players, equal stakes, six spins each, higher score wins. Fee: 10% of the players' pot on a win. A draw refunds both stakes. A bomb ends the match and the house keeps both stakes.
- [Poker](https://pvpspinarena.com/poker): six-max No-Limit Hold'em, blinds from $0.02/$0.05 to $5/$10. Fee: 5% of a pot only when a flop is dealt. Preflop hands pay no fee.
- [8-ball](https://pvpspinarena.com/8-ball-pool): 1v1, stakes $1, $2, $5, $10, $25, and $50. The winner is whoever the published rules name after the shots. The rack seed does not pick the winner. Fee: 5% of the pot when a player wins. A cancel before the break refunds both stakes.

- [Fairness](https://pvpspinarena.com/fairness): the commit-reveal protocol and an in-browser verifier

- [Editorial policy](https://pvpspinarena.com/editorial): no named author, what dates and sources mean, how to send a correction
- [Responsible gambling](https://pvpspinarena.com/responsible-gambling): limits and self-exclusion
